description: Use when you are not sure what an address is before sending to it or passing it to another tool. Sending SOL to a mint or program address can leave funds stuck. Classifies any address: normal wallet, token account, token mint, program, stake account and more, with the key facts for each. Inputs: address: Any Solana address. network (optional): Solana cluster to read. Defaults to "mainnet-beta" (real funds). Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC per call (x402). Full field-by-field docs: GET /api/tools/inspect_address.
name: inspect_address
